quote_literal_or_whitespace_proofs.literal_quote:
A unique and innovative contribution of DeYoung et al.’s (2014) was the study of

the unique variance of both Openness and Intellect aspects in relation to intelligence and

its facets. The authors sought to test the possibility that Openness, which does not

conceptually encompass intelligence, might not be associated with intelligence after

controlling for its shared variance with Intellect. Sequential regressions indicated that only

Intellect incrementally predicted g and nonverbal intelligence, while both Intellect and

Openness contributed incrementally to the prediction of verbal intelligence.

       The present study sought to replicate these findings because of their relevance in

the study of the association between intelligence and personality. This study also aimed to

extend the original study’s methodology by computing the independent associations

between aspects from all five personality traits, as opposed to only Openness to Experience,

and intelligence (g, verbal, nonverbal).

from pathlib import Path
from lxml import html
from urllib.parse import urljoin
p=Path('audit/flora_blind_2026-10/texts/2736b815e9f115a4.reports.tmp');out=json.loads(p.read_text())
def expand(x):
 if not x['name'].endswith('.html'):return x
 try:
  r=requests.get(x['url'],timeout=10);h=html.fromstring(r.content);frames=h.xpath('//iframe[@src]')
  if frames:
   u=urljoin(r.url,frames[0].get('src'));q=requests.get(u,timeout=10);q.raise_for_status();z=html.fromstring(q.content)
   for e in z.xpath('//script|//style'):e.drop_tree()
   x['text']=z.text_content();x['url']=q.url
 except Exception as e:x['iframe_error']=str(e)
 return x
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=12) as ex:out=list(ex.map(expand,out))
p.write_text(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False))
for x in out:
 if x['name'].split('.')[0] in ['child2018','okan2018','peer2022','schechtman2010','sofer2015','wal2021','zaval2015','otto2014','dale2011']:
  s=' '.join(x.get('text','').split());hits=list(re.finditer('Discussion|Summary of Replication|Summary of replication',s));pos=hits[-1].start() if hits else max(0,len(s)-6000)
  print('\nFILE',x['name'],'LENGTH',len(s),'\n',s[pos:pos+7000])
print('errors',[(x['name'],x.get('iframe_error')) for x in out if x.get('iframe_error')])
